name: 402registry
description: Checks whether AI crawlers (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, OAI-SearchBot) can see a website with a plain HTTP fetch and no JavaScript. Free tools look up a site in the public registry and return pricing, docs and service status; a new check is paid over x402 ($0.01 USDC on Base) and needs no account or API key.
author: 402registry
